title: Fix map zoom failure in CustomMapView

requirements.text: Fix the CustomMapView component so that zooming in does not cause the map to fail or crash. Ensure that tile fetching, Web Mercator projection math, marker positioning, and viewport bounds recalculation all remain stable and correct at any zoom level within the allowed min/max range. The map must remain interactive and render correctly after zoom in, zoom out, and reset operations.

quotes: this time when i zoom in it failed

acceptanceCriteria: Zooming in via scroll wheel or zoom controls does not cause a blank map, error state, or visual glitch.
Map tiles load correctly and are positioned accurately at all zoom levels.
Member markers remain correctly positioned on the map after zooming in or out.
The auto-fit bounds behavior still works correctly after a zoom interaction.
No JavaScript errors are thrown in the console during zoom operations.
Zoom in and zoom out can be performed multiple times without degradation.

constraints: Do not replace the existing OpenStreetMap/Leaflet-based or custom tile map implementation with a third-party map library.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Changing the map's visual design or theme.
Adding new map features such as clustering or new marker types.
